gen-gf-gabarito-fs-asap: Asap reads crisp and sturdy, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as the capitals. Gabarito above it is the livelier voice, with cut-open stroke ends that look drawn with a single nib, and the two feel like a showman beside a straight talker.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads clean and neutral, its curves ending well short of one another and its lowercase sitting high. Gabarito, a moderate-height display face, adds the personality on top.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-epilogue: Approachable is the first word for Epilogue, whose curvy, wire-thin letters have tall bodies and stubby ascender tips. And Gabarito, the display heading, brings a one-nib look with open stroke ends, so the page gets both swagger and a relaxed voice.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-fira-sans: Gabarito's stroke ends are cut open, letting each counter flow outward like a single nib just lifted. And Fira Sans is worth setting a touch smaller than you might expect, since its tall x-height and wide-open s curves already fill the line.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans looks sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly right. Over a long stretch of text it keeps a clean, neutral flow, while Gabarito's heading looks like vinyl cut to a single line width.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, with broad open counters on its c and s. But Gabarito's stroke ends look cut from one ribbon, so the heading feels playful while the lowercase below stays low and sturdy.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-ranade: Gabarito leads with a drawn-with-one-nib look and cut-open terminals, while Ranade below spreads out its widely spaced, organic lines. The sharpest quality here is the pairing of expressive display energy with relaxed, loose body text.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-supreme: Crisp is the right word for Supreme, which forms a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with its letters held open rather than curled shut. Gabarito sits above it with livelier, nib-drawn terminals.
gen-gf-gabarito-general-sans: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito opens with terminals cut so its counters flow outward. General Sans then follows with steady pen pressure and an x-height that fills the line, giving the pair a clear split between showy and smooth.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-orbit: Distinctive is Gabarito's strength, with a one-nib look and cut-open terminals that give headings real character. But Orbit does the quieter job, setting rope-consistent characters floating apart from each other so the text stays professional and neutral.
